The structure of Li2Mg14Ag2 (reduced formula LiMg7Ag) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 32 atoms in the unit cell across five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag and Li centers each coordinated by eight Mg neighbors, while Mg centers have between 8 and 16 neighbors, mostly Mg with some Li or Ag. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between 8-vertex Mg and 16-vertex Mg polyhedra, and edge- and face-sharing between 16-vertex Mg and 8-vertex Li or Ag polyhedra.
